Semantically, the dataset is structured to aggregate and interact with data based on events and media, while also measuring and recording spatial and temporal information. This dataset can be used for studying marine life distributions, tracking specific species, and analyzing the temporal and spatial patterns of marine events. Researchers can leverage this information for ecological studies, conservation efforts, and understanding the dynamics of marine ecosystems.
